# Latency-Sensitive Tensor Offloading Plan for Nemotron-H on 12GB GPU

## Executive Summary
This plan addresses the critical memory constraint of running Nemotron-H hybrid inference on a 12GB CUDA GPU. The architecture contains Mamba SSM tensors, attention weights, MoE expert weights, and NextN/MTP draft heads that collectively exceed typical 12GB limits. The strategy preserves latency-sensitive tensors (attention, Mamba, router) on GPU while overflowing MoE and shared-expert tensors to CPU RAM, with careful attention to the interaction between GPU offloading and speculative decoding pipelines.

## Exact Tensor Inventory & Memory Footprint

### GPU-Resident (Latency-Sensitive)
| Tensor Name | Shape | Purpose | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|
| `tok_embd` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | Token embeddings | **Keep on GPU** |
| `output_norm` | `{n_embd}` | Final RMSNorm | **Keep on GPU** |
| `output` | `{n_embd, n_vocab}` | LM head weights | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].attn_norm` | `{n_embd}` | Attention RMSNorm | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].wo` | `{n_embd_head_k * n_head_i, n_embd}` | Attention output projection | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].ssm_in` | `{n_embd, d_in_proj}` | Mamba2 input projection | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].ssm_conv1d` | `{d_conv, d_inner + 2*n_group*d_state}` | Mamba2 convolution | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].ssm_out` | `{d_inner, n_embd}` | Mamba2 output projection | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].ssm_a` | `{1, n_ssm_head}` | Mamba2 A matrix | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].ssm_d` | `{1, n_ssm_head}` | Mamba2 D matrix | **Keep on GPU** |
| `layer[i].ssm_norm` | `{d_inner / n_group, n_group}` | Mamba2 normalization | **Keep on GPU** |
